text: {"rulings": [{"id": "1", "relation": "supersedes", "reason": "CI moved from CircleCI to GitHub Actions as of 4 Jun; a project has one CI system so the CircleCI claim no longer holds."}, {"id": "2", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Whether the repo is open source has nothing to do with which CI system runs it; both remain true."}, {"id": "3", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Halcyon's approval of open-sourcing the repo is a past event and is untouched by the CI system change."}, {"id": "4", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Joy's git email is independent of the CI system; both can be true."}, {"id": "5", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The Fly.io deployment region is a separate setting from the CI system; both can be true."}]}
